tools.name: search_wholesale_products
tools.description: Search Celadon's wholesale catalog of authentic Korean skincare for businesses in the US and Canada, such as spas, estheticians, salons, barbershops, boutiques and online sellers. Every product is sold by the case with import duties included; shipping is free on orders of $150 or more ($39.90 below)

tools.name: get_wholesale_product
tools.description: Full details for one wholesale product: case size, unit and case price, US retail price, margin, key and full ingredients, stock status and product link.

tools.name: list_wholesale_brands
tools.description: All Korean skincare brands available wholesale, with product counts and the lowest case price per brand.

tools.name: quote_wholesale_order
tools.description: Price a wholesale order (quantities are in cases) and return a checkout link to celadonbeauty.com, where the buyer reviews and pays. Nothing is purchased by this tool. Includes total units, subtotal, shipping (free from $150, otherwise $39.90), estimated retail value and delivery estimate.

tools.name: get_wholesale_terms
tools.description: Celadon's wholesale terms: who can buy, pricing, case packs, payment, 6-hour cancellation, delivery, damage claims and authenticity.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_wholesale_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
